purpose: Qualitative demand/friction intelligence for young housing-benefit users who must distinguish a current 2026 decision from the monthly-income reform for decisions from 1 January 2027. Scores are not measured search volumes and do not prove eligibility, amount, decision timing, exception status or repayment outcome. Community material is discovery-only; current Försäkringskassan sources carry material claims.

scoring.priority_rule: Prioritize combinations of high demand, high friction, high consequence and weak current product coverage; these scores are not measured search volumes.

natural_language_queries: jag är student och har bostadsbidrag byter det automatiskt till månadsinkomst 2027
jag jobbar olika mycket varje månad ska jag ange månadslönen eller årsinkomsten för bostadsbidrag
mitt bostadsbidrag fortsätter in i 2027 vilka regler gäller
jag ska söka bostadsbidrag 2027 och är egenföretagare gäller månadsinkomst för mig
jag får inkomst från utlandet och söker bostadsbidrag 2027 hur räknas inkomsten
jag tar examen och börjar timjobba hur undviker jag återkrav på bostadsbidrag

demand_signal.basis: Försäkringskassan reports that 137,200 households received housing benefit during 2025, including youth households, while current community questions continue to show confusion when income varies month to month. This is a qualitative reach and discovery signal, not measured search volume.

friction_signal.basis: The product must distinguish current annual-income rules from the 2027 monthly-income reform, the start date of the decision rather than only the calendar date, and explicit exceptions for self-employment or foreign income. A user can otherwise apply the right fact to the wrong rule version.

miss_consequence.basis: Using a monthly figure for a current 2026 decision, assuming an automatic mid-decision switch, or overgeneralizing the 2027 reform can create a materially wrong next step and increase confusion around reporting and repayment risk.

source_fragmentation.basis: The current youth housing-benefit application guidance and the separate 2027 transition page must be read together, while current decision status and exception context determine which rule version is relevant.

language_accessibility_friction.basis: Terms such as annual-income estimate, monthly-income reform, decision period, existing decision, self-employment and foreign income are easy to collapse into one rule, especially for users with low digital familiarity or Arabic/Persian language needs.

steps_to_action.basis: The safest route first identifies whether the user is dealing with a current/existing decision or a new decision from 1 January 2027, then asks about the two explicit reform exceptions only when the 2027 path is relevant.

recurrence_signal.basis: Variable work hours, student-to-work transitions and fear of repayment recur in official analysis and community discovery. The 2027 rule change adds a new recurring versioning question for existing versus new decisions.

current_product_coverage_gap.basis: The truth record and scenario laboratory already encoded the 2027 decision-period and exception boundaries, but the live young-housing runtime still presented only the 2026 annual-income flow and therefore did not operationalize its own learned regression.

signals.product_miss: The single truth layer and scenario laboratory already knew that the 2027 reform is decision-versioned and has explicit exceptions, but the public young-housing flow still asked only about 2026 income change. The learned safety boundary had not reached the live product.
signals.future_guardrail: Keep one young-housing route in the shared person product. Detect explicit 2027/new-rule intent, preserve the 2026 path unchanged for current users, ask the decision-period question only for the transition path, ask the exception question only for a new-2027 decision, and never infer eligibility or amount from the rule version.
signals.evaluation_method: Run the existing v18 transition regression through the dedicated public-product gate plus sv/ar/fa routing tests. Require no automatic 1 January switch, no 2027-to-2026 backport, explicit self-employment/foreign-income fail-closed handling, a primary-source next step and privacy-safe coarse handoff.
signals.recommended_learning_action: Make the existing v18 change-intelligence regression constrain the live young-housing runtime instead of creating a duplicate scenario or a separate 2027 engine. Add a bounded transition_2027 context and decision-period/exception branching to the same person route.
signals.truth_rule: VERIFY the current Försäkringskassan rule version before a material calculation or application claim. Do not treat community discussion, a prior AI answer, the calendar date alone, or the existence of the reform as proof of eligibility, amount, repayment outcome or individual exception status.
